newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill steady at 9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill steady at 9 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India on Wednesday said it set a cut-off of 91.76 rupees at its fortnightly auction of 364-day treasury bills.
Dealers said the yield was unchanged at nine percent.
The RBI said it had accepted bids for 3.97 billion rupees.

The RBI accepted eight bids of ten received for a total of 4.72 billion rupees. It said the devolvement on primary dealers amounted to 250 million rupees. The face value of the bills issued amounted to 4.22 billion rupees.
An RBI official explained the devolvement as the difference between the underwriting commitment of the primary dealers and the allotted amount. The weighted average cut-off rate was 91.76 rupees.
